The '''Chiss aristocracy''' were the [[Noble/Legends|ruling class]] of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] were members of the aristocracy.<ref name="Joiner King" />
